POSITION SUMMARY:
The Associate Software Engineer - Full Stack supports business impact by helping build secure, reliable digital platforms that improve product delivery, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.
Working under the guidance of experienced engineers, this role contributes to modern web frontends, APIs, microservices, and data layers using established architecture and cloud practices. The engineer uses approved AI-assisted tools to support coding, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous learning while validating generated outputs.
Operating within Empower's fast-growing, highly regulated 503A/503B environment, this position follows established security, quality, and compliance requirements. The role emphasizes foundational technical skills, collaboration, disciplined execution, and a willingness to learn. With mentorship and regular code review, the associate delivers well-defined features and fixes, builds technical proficiency, and develops increasing independence while supporting mission-critical healthcare operations.

Platform Engineering
Full Stack: Contribute to application features and fixes using the team's technology stack, including TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, GraphQL, C# and Python. Collaboration and Innovation
